AccountOut.description: The owner's own view. Nobody else's account comes out of this API.
AccountOut.title: AccountOut

ActionsOut.description: What the viewer may do. The front only draws these (ADR-0011).
ActionsOut.title: ActionsOut

BoardQuery.description: The board's filters, as the URL carries them.
BoardQuery.title: BoardQuery

CarIn.description:
Same restrictions `Car` itself enforces (D-158): ninja refuses malformed input with 422
before `add_car` ever builds a domain object with it.
CarIn.title: CarIn

EditIn.description: Absent means unchanged; empty notes erase them.
EditIn.title: EditIn

ErrorOut.description: What `HttpError(status, message)` renders as: a fixed, human-readable refusal.
ErrorOut.title: ErrorOut

OriginMessageOut.description: The original WhatsApp words of an imported ride, personal data already redacted (D-117).
OriginMessageOut.title: OriginMessageOut

PlaceOut.description: What the API promises about a place, stated apart from the entity so it changes on purpose.
PlaceOut.title: PlaceOut

ProfileIn.description: Every field optional: absent means unchanged; a blank e-mail clears it (D-139).
ProfileIn.title: ProfileIn

RideCarOut.description: Model and color, as the card shows them; `accounts` has its own car schema with the plate.
RideCarOut.title: RideCarOut

RideOut.description: The card. Never the phone, never the plate (D-031).
RideOut.title: RideOut

StopIn.description:
A place of the catalog by identifier, or free text for "other" (D-013). One of the two.

`fare` is what it costs to come this far from the origin, so the first stop never has one (D-131).
StopIn.title: StopIn

ValidationErrorOut.description:
A `pydantic.ValidationError` ninja catches renders the field-by-field list; a route that
reuses 422 for its own refusal (`HttpError(422, "...")`, most of `rides`) renders the same
single message `ErrorOut` does. Both are real, so `detail` is either shape.
ValidationErrorOut.title: ValidationErrorOut

patch.description: The display name and the e-mail only: the phone and the password have their own path.

post.description: The current password proves it is really the owner, session or not (D-139).
Always `ok`: whether the phone has an account or an e-mail is not disclosed.
Create the account and log it in. The terms must be accepted (D-033).
Keep one opinion. A limit per account; no answer goes back to the person (D-155).

get.description: Places whose name or alias contains `q`, accents and case ignored. Blank lists all.
One place and everything beneath it in the hierarchy.
Rides still to depart, earliest first, filtered. `q` matches any stop, accents and case ignored.

post.description: Final (D-019). To change one's mind, repeat.
Login, a limit per account and a record: then the `wa.me` link and the plate (ADR-0006).
A new ride with this one's route, price and payment, on another departure (D-012).
Zero closes the ride; back above zero reopens it (ADR-0003).
